output: Scientific Hypothesis: An increase in income is associated with a decreased likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings, as indicated by the negative logistic regression coefficient of -0.00555. This relationship is statistically significant, as evidenced by the extremely low p-value of 8.21e-49 from the chi-squared test. The context of this hypothesis is based on the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY79) dataset, where income (INCOME) is the predictor variable and the likelihood of maintaining the same level of savings (SAMESAVE) is the response variable.
